invariants.rationale: Method returns either drawable.getMinWidth() (likely non-negative) or 0, ensuring result is never negative.
If drawable is non-null, returns drawable.getMinWidth(); else, returns 0.
If drawable is null, result is not guaranteed to match drawable.getMinWidth(); otherwise, they are equal.
If drawable is null, the method always returns 0; otherwise, returns drawable.getMinWidth().
